beats.line: Imagine naming the most universally hated and worst type of level
Water levels. Jacob's Well is a popular swimming
hole located a few miles away from Austin, Texas
And while it looks like a nice refreshing spot to hang out on a holiday
Underneath the surface lies a deadly cave system that has
taken the lives of at least nine divers in recent years
In fact some of their bodies remain inside the cave to this day
Now if for some strange reason you chose underwater cave exploring as a hobby
Your journey begins with a vertical descent into the cave but very soon
you will realize that the cave is slowly narrowing
